note: Canonical English for the School Rewards portal. The portal is served from the school's own Apps Script project and cannot call the app's translation function, so its strings live here and are published as per-language packs. Keys follow the repository convention (slug + FNV-1a hash) so this namespace can be merged into ui_strings.js unchanged.
